verdict: RED'S KILL DOES NOT SURVIVE AS A REJECT — it survives as a SIZING AND TIMING case (blue PARTIALLY OVERTURNED, 8/10). CONFIRMED against red: organic negative in all three regions, EMEA weakness is real demand (Uden thermal -0.28 C/yr corroborates), margin is broken and the guide needs a step-up disclosed only qualitatively, leverage doubled to 2.0x, AR quality drifted. REFUTED: no-inventory-build, earnings-majority OCF, dividend-at-risk, thermal-says-idled (the Holland reading is +0.09 and the two-site NA guard FAILS — Louisville disagrees at -0.53), and FATAL-by-multiple. THE NEW FACT THAT CUTS THE OTHER WAY: book-to-bill 1.05 on a $127M backlog, which makes the thesis testably 'SHIPMENT-CONSTRAINED, not demand-lost' — exactly what the original brief could not establish and what red assumed away.
lane: quality_drawdown (first courts ever run from this lane)
reopen_gates: NONE. No price gate by design (taxonomy: the open question is data/execution, not valuation). DECLINE tripwires at the ~11/02 print on ANY of: Q3 orders below Q3 revenue (book-to-bill <1.0 kills the constraint thesis outright), Q3 adj EBITDA <$40M, Q3 OCF <+$25M, or a discretionary buyback resumed with OCF negative. ADVANCE to court only on book-to-bill >=1.0 AND GM >41% AND Q3 OCF >=+$40M — and then under a FALLEN-COMPOUNDER frame with a SOURCED multiple band (TNC's own 5-yr EV/EBITDA distribution), never an assumed 8-9x.
